shortDescription: Sri Lanka plans to unveil a budget aimed at keeping its economic recovery on track amid global headwinds as its $3 billion International Monetary Fund bailout draws to a close, Bloomberg reported.

title: Sri Lanka Budget Seeks Growth as $3 Billion IMF Bailout Nears End
